newsitem.title: USA: CBOT corn seen 1 to 2 cts lower, mostly spillover.
newsitem.headline: CBOT corn seen 1 to 2 cts lower, mostly spillover.

text.p: CBOT corn futures were expected to open one to two cents per bushel lower, mostly on spillover from expected losses in corn and soybeans, traders said.
Supply and demand data from the U.S. Department of Agriculture was seen as neutral because no changes were made to old- or new-crop corn forecasts, traders said.
However, total net weekly export sales for corn were seen as supportive, traders said.
"Export sales were pretty good for both corn and wheat," said one floor trader.
USDA put old- and new-crop corn export sales at 1.10 million tonnes for the week ending June 5.
